RARE / silver-blue, faceted gems, chamfer brackets
Rarity / silver-blue, faceted gems, chamfer brackets
Portrait inlay / rank and figure emblems

text.tspan: A campaign correspondent compares dispatches with the
movement of forces and the needs of command. Clear writing
draws scattered events into focus, allowing distant
officers to act with a better understanding of one another.
